column1: # Llano Uplift case data, and where every byte came from.
# One USGS data release, doi:10.5066/F72Z14G6, Ikard and others (2019):
# "Geoelectric and Seismic Data acquired in the Precambrian Granite Gravel
# Aquifer, Llano Uplift, Central Texas, May 2017 - August 2018".
# Files are renamed for legibility and the release's own name is recorded, so a
# renamed file can still be matched back to its delivery.
# One file is not from that release and is not delivered as it stands: the 3DEP
# lidar under dem/, which is a window cut out of a 353 MB national tile. It is
# here because the release's own elevations are a whole number of feet, sit
# 2.4 m low and on ERT1 correlate -0.495 with the ground (L1, L12, L13, L15).
# Everything else is delivered untouched; a stage that crops or converts one of
# these says so in what it writes, and so does that file's own GeoTIFF tags.

column3: what_it_is
The seismograph records. 9.2 MB, and not what this case inverts: the picks below are the release's own and re-picking them would make the case an argument about picking.
Per channel: profile, channel, source location, x along the line, latitude, longitude, NAVD88 elevation. 4 m spacing.
SeisImager/2D picks for profile 1: five shots at x = 0, 20, 44, 68 and 88 m, 24 channels each.
The same for profile 2.
The authors' own tomogram for profile 1. The independent check.
The authors' own tomogram for profile 2.
Electrode coordinates for both resistivity profiles.
RES2DINV input, profile 1: 4 m electrodes, array type 11 (Wenner-Schlumberger), 243 measurements. What this case inverts.
The same for profile 2.
The authors' RES2DINV result for profile 1. The independent check.
The authors' RES2DINV result for profile 2.
The RES2DINV settings they used, so our own choices can be compared against theirs rather than invented.
One transient sounding, 100 m loop. USF is the format case 1's reader already parses.
Their IX1D model for it.
Their inversion output in text.

The one driller's log that is already a table: top and bottom depth in FEET, horizon, Munsell colour, auger diameter, notes. Records auger refusal at 7.5-8.0 ft. Uses -99999 as its null, the same sentinel as case 2's AEM (C1).
Driller's log, PDF.
Driller's log, PDF.
Driller's log, PDF.
Water level in well A, May 2017. The water table is a resistivity boundary and a velocity one, so this is the control on both.
441 self-potential measurements. No OFAG plugin; fetched so the case can say what it is not using.
The self-potential base-station drift.
FGDC metadata for the whole release.

3DEP 1 m bare-earth lidar, EPSG:26914, NAVD88, cropped to 1076 x 984 px around the survey by scripts/fetch_llano_dem.py (353 MB -> 3.0 MB). Not from doi:10.5066/F72Z14G6: sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/619c3717d34eb622f6931b2b, collected Jan-Feb 2019, five months after the survey, leaf-off. The vertical datum is the product record's, not the GeoTIFF's, which declares a horizontal CRS only. This is what the case's terrain now comes from.
